plan.title: Asset PR to Split Award PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.

args.goal: on the buyer create screen, add one required Terms and Conditions clause and set the Technical evaluation duration to 30 minutes, leaving both saved

steps.note: Handle the required T&C and exact evaluation-duration setup, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing real supplier names.
Publish the completed Technical + RFQ event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have Vendor A answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A's submission was accepted.
Have Vendor B answer the technical stage and submit a quote of 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor B's submission was accepted.
Verify the buyer sees both direct vendor responses on the RFQ stage.
Wait for bidding to end before reading rankings and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bids are closed; vendor names are asserted only if the configured QA identities expose them.
Verify the lower quote ranks better, making Vendor B rank 1.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete PO creation after the award approval.
Verify that the resulting POs contain the two awarded portions; exact vendor-per-PO and account-assignment checks remain unavailable.
Return to the events list to check the post-bidding event location.
Open the History tab where the completed event should appear.
Verify that the plan's event is present in History.
